parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The key of the business space. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value on the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the chatbot instance. Log on to the Chatbot console, choose Developer > Basic Configuration in the left-side navigation pane, and then view the chatbot instance information to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50.

parameters.name: SenderId
parameters.description: The visitor ID. This parameter is used to identify the user in the current session.

parameters.name: SessionId
parameters.description: The session ID, which is used to identify a visitor's session and maintain context information. For a new visitor, you do not need to pass this field when calling the Chat operation for the first time. The chatbot starts a session and returns the SessionId of the session in the response of the Chat operation. For subsequent conversation turns of the visitor, pass the SessionId of the current session when calling the Chat operation. The chatbot then continues the conversation turn based on the SessionId.
